_readme: Hand mounting heights over em_props' code conventions, written by the prop reference wall (prop_reference_wall.tscn) or ruled directly. A token here mounts at h everywhere the museum dresses a wall; a token absent keeps its code height. Delete the file to restore every code convention. V1: one height per token — an exit_sign rule moves both the door and the portal sign.

fire_extinguisher.why: Palle, 2026-08-14, at the reference wall: the base should sit 0.3 m from the floor — a floor-standing unit you reach DOWN to, not the EN-3 wall band the code default (1.10) assumed.
